    eps_prior = num / den

    # bonds
    interest_at = Q(2000000) * Q("0.08") * (1 - Q("0.25"))
    conv = Q(150000)
    bond_eps = interest_at / conv

    if bond_eps < eps_prior:
        diluted = (num + interest_at) / (den + conv)
    else:
        diluted = eps_prior

    return {
        "final": diluted,
        "weighted_shares": weighted,
        "basic_eps": basic,
        "option_incremental_shares": opt_inc,
        "bond_incremental_eps": bond_eps,
    }
